snapshotBody: Showing the page as it last loaded successfully, {age} (no sandbox cost). You can browse and annotate it; wake the app to interact.
noSnapshot: This app has no snapshot yet. Wake it to keep going; every successful load from now on keeps one.
hint: A frozen environment comes back in seconds; one already reclaimed takes a turn from the teammate to start the app again, about 20–40 seconds. Progress is shown step by step
stepPort: Wait for the port to answer
wakeTimeout: The app is still not up after {seconds} seconds. Try again, or ask {agent} in the conversation.
tooLarge: This page is too large to keep a snapshot of. Wake it to carry on.
